items.originalTitle: McLaren retains Leonardo Fornaroli in F1 as Italian adds WEC programme for 2027
items.summaryEn: McLaren has confirmed that Leonardo Fornaroli will continue as its F1 reserve and third driver in 2027, while also making his World Endurance Championship debut in the team's new Hypercar.
detailZh: 迈凯伦留用莱昂纳多·福尔纳罗利任F1储备车手，这位意大利车手还将增加2027年WEC参赛计划
莱昂纳多·福尔纳罗利将在2027年继续担任迈凯伦的F1储备及第三车手，同时驾驶该车队的新款Hypercar参加世界耐力锦标赛。在接受Motorsport.com独家采访时，他谈到了自己驾驶赛车的最初感受、重返比赛的渴望以及参加勒芒的梦想。
迈凯伦重申了对莱昂纳多·福尔纳罗利的信任，并进一步加深了对这位意大利车手的投入。福尔纳罗利已确认担任F1车队2027赛季的储备及第三车手，但他的计划还将包括第二项重要挑战：驾驶迈凯伦新款Hypercar完成世界耐力锦标赛首秀。
这标志着福尔纳罗利职业生涯重要新篇章的开始，让他能够在F1继续发展的同时重返顶级竞争，并为推动这家总部位于沃金的车队重返耐力赛巅峰的项目做出贡献。
他继续参与迈凯伦F1项目是重要的一步。整个2026年，福尔纳罗利通过一个包含旧车测试（TPC）环节、两次大奖赛自由练习出场以及大量模拟器工作的项目，加强了与车队的联系。该发展项目将在下个赛季与他的WEC承诺一同继续。
“迈凯伦今年给我的项目非常棒，”福尔纳罗利告诉Motorsport.com。“我与车队完成的TPC测试日、两次FP1环节以及我在模拟器上做的所有工作都是极其宝贵的经历。每次与车队合作，我都能学到新东西。我想感谢迈凯伦给予我的支持和发展机会。”
在F1中获得的经验也将为他在耐力赛中的新挑战提供重要基础，这项赛事不可避免地需要一段适应期。福尔纳罗利对此心知肚明，但他相信迄今为止的经验已为他配备了宝贵的工具。
“所有这些对WEC也将非常重要，因为这是一个竞争极其激烈的锦标赛，有太多东西要学，从超车到策略，当然还有了解一辆全新的赛车。”
福尔纳罗利已经首次体验了迈凯伦Hypercar，尽管他最初的驾驶体验仅限于短短几公里。
昨天，这位意大利人完成了单圈，足以让他感受到前所未有的感觉。他与车队的首次正式测试定于今天开始，这将使他更熟悉Hypercar，并在其WEC首秀前开始研发工作。
“这是一次很棒的经历，”福尔纳罗利承认。“第一次进入封闭式座舱，关上车门，先以电力驱动起步，然后内燃机介入，这对我来说完全是全新的，但真的非常酷。我迫不及待地想回到车里，与车队一起完成我的第一个正式公里数。”
福尔纳罗利还将在Hypercar的研发中发挥积极作用，进一步凸显他对该项目的参与。迈凯伦将以相当大的雄心进入其首个WEC赛季，这位年轻的意大利人相信，该组织拥有一切所需来应对挑战。
能成为这个项目的一部分，感觉太棒了。显然，这将是我们参加WEC的第一年，但我非常有信心。车手阵容极具竞争力，既有经验非常丰富的车手，也有天赋出众的年轻车手。
工程师们技艺高超，机械师们也是如此。我们说的是迈凯伦，一支在赛车运动历史上取得过一些令人难以置信的成就的车队。明年和他们一起比赛将会非常棒。
除了技术层面和职业机会之外，耐力赛项目还满足了福尔纳罗利从未试图掩饰的一个愿望：重返赛场。
在作为储备车手基本只能旁观、观察一支一级方程式车队内部运作的一个赛季之后，再次轮对轮竞争的前景提供了特别强大的动力。
“是的，我真的很想念比赛，”他承认道。“每个周末我作为替补车手来到赛道，看到兰多和奥斯卡在比赛时，我都会非常嫉妒。所以重返赛场将是一种不可思议的感觉。”
2027年的赛历还将包含一个特别特殊的赛事：勒芒24小时耐力赛。对福尔纳罗利来说，这不仅仅是赛季中最重要的比赛之一。这意味着他将比预期更早地实现一个长久以来的抱负。
“绝对如此。勒芒一直是我的梦想。我从未想过能早在明年就有机会去那里比赛。
“这是我多年来一直在想的一场比赛，能这么快就参与其中将令人难以置信。我每年都关注勒芒24小时耐力赛，甚至会熬夜到深夜观看。我认为首次在勒芒这样一个独特的地方比赛将是一种非常特别的感觉。”
因此，2027赛季对福尔纳罗利的未来而言将是一个尤为关键的赛季。
一方面，他将继续留在迈凯伦的一级方程式计划中，有机会进一步巩固与车队的关系并延续自身发展。另一方面，他将重返最高水平的锦标赛赛场参与竞争，同时在研发一款全新赛车的过程中发挥积极作用。
这是两项不同但相辅相成的任务，迈凯伦将通过它们继续投资这位年轻的意大利车手，为他提供一套结合了车手培养、技术经验以及或许对福尔纳罗利而言最重要的再次参赛机会的计划。
detailEn: McLaren retains Leonardo Fornaroli in F1 as Italian adds WEC programme for 2027

Leonardo Fornaroli will continue as McLaren's F1 reserve and third driver in 2027, while also taking on the World Endurance Championship with the squad's new Hypercar. In an exclusive interview with Motorsport.com, he discusses his first impressions behind the wheel, his desire to return to racing and his dream of competing at Le Mans.

McLaren has reaffirmed its faith in Leonardo Fornaroli – and is taking its commitment to the Italian driver a step further. Fornaroli has been confirmed as the Formula 1 team's reserve and third driver for the 2027 season, but his programme will also include a second, prestigious challenge: making his World Endurance Championship debut behind the wheel of McLaren's new Hypercar.

It marks the beginning of an important new chapter in Fornaroli's career, allowing him to continue his development in F1 while returning to top-level competition and contributing to a project that will bring the Woking-based manufacturer back to the pinnacle of endurance racing.

His continued involvement in McLaren's F1 programme is a significant step. Throughout 2026, Fornaroli has strengthened his relationship with the team through a programme that has included Testing of Previous Cars (TPC) sessions, two Grand Prix free practice appearances and extensive simulator work. That development programme will continue next season alongside his WEC commitments.

"The programme McLaren has given me this year has been incredible," Fornaroli told Motorsport.com. "The TPC days I've completed with the team, the two FP1 sessions and all the work I've done in the simulator have been extremely valuable experiences. Every time I work with the team, I learn something new. I want to thank McLaren for the support and the development opportunities they're giving me."

The experience gained in F1 will also provide an important foundation for his new challenge in endurance racing, a discipline that will inevitably require a period of adaptation. Fornaroli is well aware of that, but believes his experience so far has equipped him with valuable tools.

"All of this will also be very important for the WEC, because it's an extremely competitive championship and there will be so much to learn, from overtaking to strategy, as well as, of course, getting to know a completely new car."
Fornaroli has already had his first taste of the McLaren Hypercar, although his initial experience behind the wheel was limited to just a handful of kilometres.

Yesterday, the Italian completed a single lap, enough to discover sensations unlike anything he had experienced before. His first proper test with the team is scheduled to begin today, allowing him to become more familiar with the Hypercar and start development work ahead of its WEC debut.

"It was a great experience," Fornaroli admitted. "Getting into a closed cockpit for the first time, shutting the door and setting off first on electric power before the combustion engine kicked in was something completely new to me, but really, really cool. I can't wait to get back in the car and complete my first proper kilometres with the team."

Fornaroli will also play an active role in developing the Hypercar, further underscoring his involvement in the project. McLaren will enter its debut WEC season with considerable ambitions, and the young Italian is confident that the organisation has everything it needs to meet the challenge.

"It's an amazing feeling to be part of this programme. Obviously, it will be our first year in the WEC, but I'm very confident. The driver line-up is extremely competitive, with some very experienced drivers and some very talented young drivers.

"The engineers are highly skilled, and so are the mechanics. We're talking about McLaren, a team that has achieved some incredible successes throughout motorsport history. Racing with them next year is going to be amazing."
Beyond the technical aspects and the career opportunities, the endurance programme also fulfils a desire Fornaroli has never tried to hide: getting back to racing.

After a season spent largely on the sidelines as a reserve driver, observing the inner workings of a Formula 1 team, the prospect of competing wheel-to-wheel again provides a particularly powerful motivation.

"Yes, I've really missed racing," he admitted. "Every weekend I'm at the track as a reserve driver, I get very jealous when I see Lando and Oscar racing. So getting back to racing is going to be an incredible feeling."

The 2027 calendar will also feature a particularly special event: the 24 Hours of Le Mans. For Fornaroli, it will be more than just one of the most important races of the season. It will mean fulfilling a long-held ambition much sooner than he ever expected.
"Absolutely. Le Mans has always been a dream of mine. I never expected to have the opportunity to race there as early as next year.

"It's a race I've thought about for many years, and to be able to take part so soon will be incredible. I follow the 24 Hours every year, even staying up late into the night to watch it. I think it will be a very special feeling to race at such a unique place as Le Mans for the first time."
The 2027 season is therefore shaping up to be a particularly important one for Fornaroli's future.

On one hand, he will maintain his place within McLaren's Formula 1 programme, with the opportunity to further strengthen his relationship with the team and continue his development. On the other, he will return to competitive racing in a world championship of the highest level, while playing an active role in developing an entirely new car.

Two different but complementary commitments through which McLaren will continue to invest in the young Italian, offering him a programme that combines driver development, technical experience and, perhaps most importantly for Fornaroli, the chance to race again.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen jokes he will need a "new spine" after "incredibly bumpy" US GP circuit
items.summaryEn: Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has warned that the Circuit of the Americas (COTA) is "incredibly bumpy" ahead of the United States Grand Prix, joking that he may need to "order a new spine" afterwards.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘调侃称，在"极其颠簸"的美国大奖赛赛道上比赛后，他可能需要一根"新脊椎"。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在美国大奖赛前警告，美洲赛道（COTA）的路面极其颠簸。
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
四届F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘在美国大奖赛前警告，美洲赛道（COTA）路面"极其颠簸"，并开玩笑说自己赛后可能需要"订购一根新脊椎"。
这位红牛车手带着在巴林大奖赛、马来西亚和新加坡大奖赛连续两场胜利的势头前往奥斯汀。然而，维斯塔潘对奥斯汀的比赛降低了期望。
“我的意思是，这很难说。我现在不想说我会在奥斯汀参与争夺，但没错，最近几个比赛周末非常棒，”这位荷兰车手在新加坡大奖赛赛后新闻发布会上解释道。
“但我只是一场一场地看，等我们到了奥斯汀，再看看那里会怎么样。但那又是一条非常不同的赛道。”
他观看了世界耐力锦标赛在美洲赛道（COTA）的比赛，这让他对赛道表面感到担忧。
“从我在WEC看到的情况来看，这条赛道颠簸得难以置信。天哪，这个周末过后我大概得订一根新脊椎，或者变成机械战警那样。太疯狂了，”他开玩笑说。
“这对每个人来说又是一个新的挑战，你知道的，要应对那些颠簸。然后我们就从那里继续前进。我们还得去墨西哥，同样是高海拔，一切都会运行得超级热。
“我们需要看看引擎在那个海拔下会表现如何，赛车的行为如何，因为那非常不同。所以，你知道，在那些比赛中有太多不同的事情你可能做对或做错，但我们拭目以待。”
2026赛季还剩六轮，假设最后两场在卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛按计划进行，维斯塔潘目前位居车手积分榜第四。但在过去两个比赛周末（包括一场冲刺赛）共收获58分后，他已将与第三名刘易斯·汉密尔顿的差距缩小到仅8分，与第二名乔治·拉塞尔的差距缩小到17分。
detailEn: Max Verstappen jokes he will need a "new spine" after "incredibly bumpy" US GP circuit
Max Verstappen has warned of the extremely bumpy track surface at the Circuit of the Americas ahead of the United States Grand Prix
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has warned that the Circuit of the Americas (COTA) is "incredibly bumpy" ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix, joking he may need to "order a new spine" afterwards.

The Red Bull driver heads to Austin with the momentum of two consecutive victories at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia and the Singapore Grand Prix. However, Verstappen has tempered expectations for the race in Austin.

"I mean, it's very difficult to say. I don't want to say now that I will be in the fight in Austin, but yeah, the last few weekends have been great," the Dutchman explained during the Singapore Grand Prix post-race press conference.
"But I just take it race by race, and once we are in Austin, then we'll see how it will go there. But it's again a very different track."
He watched the World Endurance Championship's visit to COTA, which left him concerned about the track surface.
"From what I saw in WEC, the track is incredibly bumpy. Oh my god, I probably need to order a new spine after the weekend or become like Robocop. Crazy," he joked.
"That's again a new challenge for everyone, you know, to deal with those bumps. And then we just go from there. We have to go to Mexico, again, high altitude, everything will run super hot.

"We need to see how the engine is going to perform at that altitude, how the car is behaving, because it's very different. So, you know, there are so many different things that you can get right or wrong in those races, but we'll see."

With six rounds remaining in the 2026 season, assuming the final two races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi continue as planned, Verstappen currently sits fourth in the drivers' standings. But after collecting 58 points across the last two race weekends, including a sprint race, he has closed the gap to Lewis Hamilton in third to just eight points and George Russell in second to 17 points.

items.originalTitle: George Russell hints at hidden struggles behind 2025 Singapore GP victory
items.summaryEn: George Russell has revealed he was dealing with "a lot" behind the scenes during the weekend of his 2025 Singapore Grand Prix victory, saying "not many people know" what was happening away from the track.
detailZh: 拉塞尔暗示2025新加坡站胜利背后有隐情
拉塞尔透露，在2025年新加坡大奖赛夺冠期间，他在幕后面对着未公开的挑战
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
拉塞尔透露，在2025年新加坡大奖赛夺冠的那个周末，他在幕后应对着“很多”事情，并表示“没有多少人知道”赛道之外发生了什么。
这位梅赛德斯车手是在接受奥地利广播机构ORF Sport采访时说这番话的，该机构向他展示了去年他在滨海湾街道赛道与伴侣卡门·蒙特罗·蒙德特庆祝夺冠的照片。
“我的意思是，那是一个非常特别的周末，因为幕后有很多不为众人所知的事情在发生。”
当采访者请他暗示一下所指何事时，这位英国车手拒绝了：“不，总有一天吧。”
他接着解释了为什么这些照片对他意义重大。
“心理上，我的大脑相当忙碌，”拉塞尔补充道。“然后出场，拿下杆位，赢得比赛，那真是一个非常特别的时刻，而且卡门也在那里。”
“为什么这些照片和这个时刻对我如此重要，是因为在我应对赛道外那些时刻的过程中，她一直陪伴在我身边，所以这是人们看不到的部分。”
2025年新加坡大奖赛的胜利是他那个赛季的第二场胜利，也弥补了此前在滨海湾的失望。2023年，他在最后一圈跑在第三位时撞车，丢掉了一个几乎到手的领奖台。
本赛季，拉塞尔以238分位居车手积分榜第二，落后梅赛德斯队友安东内利102分。法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以229分排名第三。
“我会继续每场比赛都全力拼搏，直到数学上不再可能为止，”拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末期间对媒体表示。
“这不会改变我对待工作的方式。我想努力赢下每一场比赛，并在每一场比赛中夺得杆位。
“这就是我的目标。这就是我每个周末都在努力追求的东西，之后会发生什么就顺其自然。显然存在巨大的积分差距，但现在这甚至不在考虑范围内。表现才是最大的优先事项。
“我不认为之前我从争冠的角度给自己施加了压力。我是从表现的角度给自己施加了压力。我目前在积分榜上处于这个位置，是因为表现还不够强劲。
“一段时间以来，压力一直来自努力提升性能，而不是想着我需要为这个冠军而战，因为只有当你具备性能时，你才能为冠军而战。”
detailEn: George Russell hints at hidden struggles behind 2025 Singapore GP victory
George Russell has revealed he faced undisclosed challenges behind the scenes during his 2025 Singapore Grand Prix victory
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

George Russell has revealed he was dealing with "a lot" behind the scenes during the weekend of his 2025 Singapore Grand Prix victory, saying "not many people know" what was happening away from the track.

The Mercedes driver was speaking to Austrian broadcaster ORF Sport, which showed him photographs of himself celebrating last year's win at the Marina Bay Street Circuit with his partner, Carmen Montero Mundt.
"I mean, it was a very special weekend because there was a lot going on behind the scenes that not many people know about."
When the interviewer asked him to give a hint about what he meant, the Briton declined: "No, one day."
He went on to explain why the images meant so much to him.
"Psychologically, my brain was quite busy," Russell added. "Then going out, putting it on pole, winning the race was a really special moment and having Carmen there as well.
"Why these photos and this moment were so important to me is because she was there through those moments off the track that I was dealing with, so this is the part that people don't see."

The 2025 Singapore Grand Prix win was his second victory of that season and made up for previous disappointments at Marina Bay. In 2023, he crashed on the final lap while running third, throwing away a likely podium.
This season, Russell sits second in the drivers' standings with 238 points, 102 points behind his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli. Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton is third with 229 points.
"I'm going to keep fighting every single race until it's mathematically impossible," Russell told the media during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend.
"It doesn't change how I go about my job. I want to try and win every single race and put it on pole every single race.

"That's my goal. That's what I'm working towards every single weekend and what happens thereafter will be. There's obviously a huge deficit, but it's not even a consideration right now. The performance is the biggest priority.

"I don't think I was really putting pressure on myself before from a championship standpoint. I was putting pressure on myself from a performance perspective. I'm in this position in the championship because the performance hasn't been strong enough.

"It's been the case for a while where the pressure has come from trying to improve the performance, rather than thinking I need to fight for this championship because you can only fight for a championship if you've got the performance."

该采访中，ORF Sport向他展示了去年他在滨海湾街道赛道与伴侣庆祝夺冠的照片

During the interview, ORF Sport showed him photographs of himself celebrating last year's win at the Marina Bay Street Circuit with his partner.

items.originalTitle: Gabriel Bortoleto seeks Red Bull lessons from Max Verstappen during gaming sessions
detailZh: 加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托在游戏环节中向红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘学习赛车技巧
奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托在在线赛车时，经常与红牛的朋友讨论车队发展
加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托，奥迪F1车队，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队
奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托和红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘在F1之外是亲密的朋友，两人在在线游戏环节中经常一起赛车。Motorsport.com确认，巴西人向这位四次冠军询问红牛如何成长为冠军车队，他希望将这些经验应用到奥迪车队。
这是博尔特罗托在锦标赛中的第二个赛季，也是他首次以奥迪全厂队的身份参赛。他在车手积分榜上排名第15，积10分，而奥迪车队在车队积分榜上排名第8，这得益于他和队友尼克·胡肯伯格的努力。相比之下，德国人已经获得了13分。
‘我经常和马克斯交谈，’博尔特罗托说。‘显然，细节我们之间保留，但我们经常谈论我的感受，我的发展，我对奥迪的期望以及我们作为团队的发展。我会问他关于他在赢得世界冠军之前在红牛的经历：当时的情况如何，团队是如何运作的。’
加布里埃尔·博尔特罗托，奥迪F1车队，马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，伊萨克·哈吉亚，红牛车队
这些问题经常在模拟赛车游戏中出现。‘这些是在我们玩游戏时有时会出现在我脑海中的事情，所以我问他，’博尔特罗托说。他还补充说，游戏也是他放松的方式：‘我在笑，我在享受乐趣，这不是工作。’
博托莱托状态出色。他在2023年赢得了三级方程式锦标赛冠军，并在2024年赢得了二级方程式锦标赛冠军，当时伊萨克·哈德贾是他最接近的竞争对手，基米·安东内利排名第六。这些成绩使他获得了与萨博的F1席位，在奥迪接手2026年之前。
博托莱托和维斯塔潘将在本周末的美国大奖赛奥斯汀站重新亮相。
detailEn: Gabriel Bortoleto seeks Red Bull lessons from Max Verstappen during gaming sessions
The Audi driver regularly discusses team development with his Red Bull friend while racing online
Gabriel Bortoleto, Audi F1 Team, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing

Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto and Red Bull's Max Verstappen are close friends outside of Formula 1, with the pair often seen racing together during online gaming sessions. Motorsport.com can confirm that the Brazilian asked the four-time champion how Red Bull grew into a championship-winning team as he looks to apply these learnings to Audi.

This is Bortoleto's second season in the championship and first with Audi as a full works team. He sits 15th in the drivers' standings on 10 points, with Audi eighth in the constructors' standings thanks to his and team-mate Nico Hulkenberg's efforts. The German, in comparison, has scored 13 points.

"I talk to Max often," Bortoleto said. "Obviously, the details stay between us, but we often talk about how I'm feeling, how I'm developing, what I want from Audi and how we're progressing as a team. I ask him questions about what he experienced at Red Bull before winning the world championship: what things were like, how the team worked."
Gabriel Bortoleto, Audi F1 Team, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

Those questions often come up mid-sim race. “These are things that sometimes come into my head while we’re playing, so I ask him,” Bortoleto said. He added that gaming is also his way of switching off: “I’m laughing, I’m having fun, it’s not work.”

Bortoleto has strong form. He won the Formula 3 title in 2023 and Formula 2 in 2024, when Isack Hadjar was his closest rival and Kimi Antonelli finished sixth. Those results earned him his F1 seat with Sauber before Audi took over for 2026.
Bortoleto and Verstappen will be back in action at this weekend’s United States Grand Prix in Austin.

items.originalTitle: George Russell claims unofficial 2026 F1 sprint title
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在2026年F1新加坡大奖赛中，在兰多·诺里斯与他的麦凯轮车队队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里最后一圈发生碰撞后，成为了2026年F1冲刺赛的‘非官方’冠军。
乔治·拉塞尔在2026年F1冲刺赛上以计分回退的方式领先查尔斯·勒克莱尔，成为了冠军。
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析，来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯。
如果F1官方承认了这一冠军头衔，乔治·拉塞尔本应在2026年成为F1冲刺赛的冠军。
虽然拉塞尔目前看到他的冠军头衔希望逐渐消失，因为他的梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利在积分榜上继续扩大领先优势，但这位英国人在短距离赛中取得了胜利。
虽然没有官方的短距离赛冠军，但随着六场短距离赛全部完成，非官方的结果已经公布。
拉塞尔和法拉利的查尔斯·勒克莱尔在中国的上海、美国的迈阿密、加拿大的蒙特利尔、英国的银石、荷兰的阿斯尔和新加坡的短距离赛中总共获得了34分。拉塞尔因为赢得了其中的三场而获得了胜利，而勒克莱尔虽然没有赢得任何一场短距离赛，但也获得了34分。
诺里斯在迈阿密的胜利使他落后一分，获得了33分。在领先的三个车手之后，安东内利获得了31分，刘易斯·汉密尔顿27分，皮亚斯特里21分，马克斯·维斯塔潘20分。
冲刺赛中，前八名选手将获得积分，冠军获得8分，第八名获得1分。
至于主要锦标赛，还剩下六轮比赛，假设卡塔尔和阿布扎比大奖赛按计划进行。安东内利目前以340分领先。拉塞尔和汉密尔顿分别以238分和229分排在第二和第三位。
维斯塔潘以221分排在第四位，他将带着在马来西亚巴林大奖赛和新加坡大奖赛连续两场胜利的势头参加即将到来的美国大奖赛。
勒克莱尔以215分排在第五位。

detailEn: George Russell claims unofficial 2026 F1 sprint title
George Russell has topped the unofficial 2026 Formula 1 sprint championship on countback ahead of Charles Leclerc
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
George Russell would have been crowned sprint champion in 2026, if F1 had awarded such a title, after Lando Norris's last-lap clash with his McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri in Singapore.

While Russell is currently watching his championship title hopes slip away as his Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli continues to extend his lead in the standings, the Briton has come out on top in the sprint races.
There is no official sprint championship, but with all six sprints completed, the unofficial results are in.

Russell and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc both scored 34 points across the six sprint races in China, Miami, Canada, Britain, the Netherlands and Singapore. Russell claimed it on countback because he won three of them and Leclerc collected 34 points without a sprint win.
Norris finished one point behind on 33 with his win in Miami. Behind the leading three, Antonelli scored 31 points, Lewis Hamilton 27, Piastri 21 and Max Verstappen 20.
Points are awarded to the top eight finishers in sprint races from eight points for the winner to one point for eighth place.

As for the main championship, six rounds remain, assuming the Qatar and Abu Dhabi Grands Prix go ahead as planned. Antonelli currently leads with 340 points. Russell and Hamilton follow in second and third with 238 and 229 points respectively.
Verstappen sits fourth with 221 points and will arrive at the upcoming United States Grand Prix on the back of two consecutive wins at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia and the Singapore Grand Prix.
Rounding out the top five is Leclerc with 215 points.
